task_reconstruction: Score a city's growth by a cube whose axes are economy, society and environment, fold direction and speed into one index, then split a fixed budget across seven services to push that index up for Edinburgh and Wellington.

contributions.summary: one index that adds a direction cosine to a weighted growth length
a pass rule based on the lowest of the three axes, separate from the grade
a seven part budget chosen by maximizing the same index
a response of the three indexes to budget fitted in closed form

the fitted response links budget to the indexes

assumptions.summary: the statistics from official sites are reliable
politics and the economy stay stable, with no disaster or scandal
the next decades continue the last one
the budget is capped and is the main driver of growth

data_and_preprocessing.summary: edinburgh taken from scotland's census, wellington from statistics new zealand
the current state is the mean of 2013 to 2015 and the previous state the mean of 2004 to 2006
the current budget is the average of 2009 to 2015
